paraphrase: There are explicit finite semantic controls: in a two-world, two-content interpretation, the duty-content is true at the designated actual world but a policy selecting only the consistent duty-denying worldview satisfies the consistency norm and fails the duty-compatibility norm. In a one-world interpretation, an empty consistent worldview entails a tautological content without explicitly accepting it. Thus a consistency-only requirement does not entail reflective compatibility with a true duty, and logical implication does not require psychological belief in every implication. The models are stipulated, not claims about people's beliefs or metaphysical possibilities.
